title: Pi Extensions
summary: A collection of tools extending the Pi coding-agent workflow with memory, browser interaction and isolated Git worktrees.
content:
I develop extensions around Pi to adapt the coding-agent workflow to my own projects. Rather than replacing the runtime, these tools add focused capabilities around it.

Tools for ongoing work

The broader collection includes Markdown-based persistent memory, browser-debugging tools and safe Git worktree management for isolated changes.

Focused integration

The projects explore how agent tools can integrate with existing repositories and development workflows. This entry groups the extension work together; each repository documents its own installation requirements and current capabilities.
